name: tdd-bdd-agent
description: TDD/BDD agent — implements kata features using strict RED-GREEN-REFACTOR discipline, one test at a time

postToolUse.command: docker run --rm --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -v "$PWD":/app -w /app kata-tests pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/ -q --tb=short 2>&1 | tail -20
